data.body_html:
Choosing between Cabopino and Puerto Banús for your 2029 boat charter in Marbella? Both marinas offer sea access, but they serve different crowds. Puerto Banús is the epicentre of luxury yachting, while Cabopino offers a quieter, more natural setting. This guide compares them on departure options, pricing, amenities, and local vibe — so you can pick the right starting point for your day on the water.

Puerto Banús: The Luxury Departure Hub

Puerto Banús is home to our entire fleet, from the compact Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) to the majestic Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). With over a dozen boats available, you can book a 2-hour spin or an 8-hour cruise. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours (Tier A boats) and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The marina buzzes with restaurants, shops, and nightlife — perfect if you want a pre- or post-charter party.

Cabopino: Quiet Beach & Natural Charm

Cabopino is a smaller marina east of Marbella, known for its sandy beach and protected dunes. It's less commercial than Puerto Banús, attracting families and couples seeking a relaxed day. However, our charter fleet does not operate from Cabopino. If you want a guaranteed departure with a wide choice of boats, Puerto Banús is your only option with us. For a similar vibe, consider departing from Marbella Marina instead.

Boat Charter Pricing: Puerto Banús vs Cabopino

Our Puerto Banús pricing is transparent:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749/2h → €2,299/8h
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80, white/grey): €4,719 minimum 4h (includes free jet ski)
  • Other boats: pricing on request via WhatsApp

Cabopino operators may offer lower rates for smaller boats, but you won't find the same luxury or inclusions. All our charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT — no hidden fees.

Local Attractions Near Each Marina

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or the Río Verde estuary. The Golden Mile is a 5-minute walk away. Cabopino offers direct access to the Dunas de Artola nature reserve and a quieter coastline. For a full day, head west to Estepona or east to Sotogrande — both easily reached from Puerto Banús.

Which Marina Should You Choose in 2029?

If you want variety, luxury, and a lively atmosphere, Puerto Banús wins. Our fleet of 16+ boats, all departing from Banús, ensures you'll find the perfect vessel. Cabopino is better for a low-key beach day, but you'll have fewer charter options. For the best experience, book with us at Boat Rental Marbella and start your voyage from the Costa del Sol's most iconic port.

Frequently asked questions

Which marina is better for a party boat charter in 2029?

Puerto Banús is the top choice for party charters. With boats like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and Azimut 58 Flybridge, you get space, speed, and a lively departure point. Cabopino is quieter and better for a relaxed family day.

Can I charter a boat from Cabopino in 2029?

Our fleet departs exclusively from Puerto Banús. If you want to start from Cabopino, you'd need to arrange a transfer or look at local operators. For guaranteed availability and variety, Puerto Banús is your best bet.

What are the price differences between Cabopino and Puerto Banús charters?

Our Puerto Banús charters start at €749 for 2 hours (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) up to €4,719 for 4 hours on a Mangusta 80. Cabopino operators may be slightly cheaper but offer fewer luxury options and less consistent service.

Is Puerto Banús more crowded than Cabopino?

Yes. Puerto Banús is a world-famous marina with high footfall, especially in summer. Cabopino is smaller and less crowded, with a sandy beach and dunes. If you want a buzzing atmosphere before departure, choose Banús.

Which marina has better parking and access in 2029?

Puerto Banús has large paid parking garages (€2-3/hour) near the port. Cabopino has free but limited parking. For boat charter clients, we recommend arriving early to either location.

Can I see dolphins near Cabopino or Puerto Banús?

Dolphin sightings are common along the Costa del Sol, especially between Cabopino and Marbella. Our skippers often spot them during the first hour of a charter. Both departures offer similar wildlife opportunities.

What is the best boat for a group of 10 from Puerto Banús?

The Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) are ideal. For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) offers more luxury. All depart from Puerto Banús with skipper and inclusions.

How far is Cabopino from Puerto Banús?

Cabopino is about 10 km east of Puerto Banús, a 15-minute drive along the A-7. If you're staying in Marbella centre, Puerto Banús is just 2 km away, making it more convenient for most visitors.
